items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for bounded public beta or full launch; conditional only for continued private preview. Evidence supports the private gate: password protection, noindex/nofollow, zero reported SEO activity, unavailable analytics and Data Hub sources, incomplete affiliate attribution, and no completed evidence for source rights, accuracy, privacy, consent, terms, cookie/analytics disclosure, affiliate disclosure, platform policy, content or age screening, security, incident handling, or rollback. Require the owner to choose keep-private, bounded beta, or full launch; retain keep-private unless the applicable checklist is complete. Data-use decisions: Woot API deal and price-history data—evidence_needed; obtain current API terms or written permission, field-level provenance, freshness behavior, and correction/takedown controls; smallest action is an owner-approved rights-and-data inventory. User alert rules and sync results—evidence_needed; document fields, retention/deletion, access controls, Slack or email processor terms, consent, and unsubscribe behavior; smallest action is a data-flow and retention table. GA4—evidence_needed; verify deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdiction treatment; smallest action is a read-only consent/configuration evidence capture. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data—evidence_needed; inventory log fields, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures; smallest action is an operator-produced log and vendor inventory. Human counsel is required for unresolved source-license or API-rights questions, privacy or consent scope, consumer and affiliate disclosures, copyright/trademark use, platform-policy restrictions, or regulated or age-sensitive content. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as a reason to block ordinary growth generally, but it is not sufficient evidence for this gated public launch. No sitemap, monetization expansion, production change, or go-live approval is recommended.

Public beta or full launch is blocked; continued private preview is conditional. Retain the owner-facing launch decision pending evidence for source rights, provenance, accuracy, privacy, consent, terms, disclosures, platform policy, content screening, security, attribution, margin, rollback, and counsel review of material uncertainty.
